status: Retained research hypothesis, not GPU-ready or demonstrated improvement
name: ReBalance coefficient-scaled lexical penalty
formula: lambda(c)=ln(2)*clip(c/c_min,0,1), c_min=min(frozen_model_fit.low_val_1, frozen_model_fit.low_val_2); require original RC14 eligibility; nonfinite c gives zero
unique_change: Only lexical penalty magnitude; keep original14, history_gate=none, model-specific R vector/layer/fit, and sampling fixed.
mechanism: Remove jump from zero to full ln2 at c=0. A weak negative activation-steering command receives weak lexical suppression; strong negative commands retain original penalty.
not_assumed: Coefficient magnitude is not a correctness probability.
Strong negative commands are not proven to benefit from stronger word suppression.
This can reduce compression by restoring useful or useless reflection.
May be no better than a fixed weaker penalty.

evidence.scope: Float64 reconstruction on saved calibration steps; quartiles match frozen fit, not exact online eligibility.

implementation.interface: Prospective penalty_mode=fixed|coefficient_scaled|calibration_constant; default fixed, unimplemented in live adapter.
implementation.placement: Sampler.__call__, after reading original s._coefs and building original mask; before original_sampler temperature/top-p.
implementation.ordering: R raw maximum softmax confidence is saved before lexical penalty; original_sampler samples; native runner consumes accepted token and saved confidence; next invocation uses resulting R coefficient.
implementation.state: No new per-request adaptive history. Model-specific lower bound is immutable; mixed-model configurations rejected. Existing slot resets/think/end/clean-opening logic unchanged.
implementation.off_contract: mode=off returns before reading fit or installing hooks. penalty_mode=fixed preserves exact existing operation order and buffers. Do not route fixed through a new multiply.
implementation.replay: If implemented, shared pure penalty policy used by both native adapter and replay adapter; no copied controller; preemption remains rejected in async path until separately validated.
implementation.cost: No extra forward/probe/RNG. Adds per-live-row division and clamp before existing lexical update; device cost not measured.

required_controls: RC14 with fixed reduced penalty matched to calibration mean eligible scaled penalty
constant_control: Do not use audit all-negative-step mean as final setting. Replay original calibration token boundaries/clean openings and R states, freeze mean over eligible lexical slots before any candidate generation. Off-policy calibration mean is only approximate dose matching, not matched realized dose after paths diverge.
pre_gpu_cpu_tasks: Verify coefficient reconstruction against pinned Torch FP32 computation when an existing suitable runtime is available; no installation.
Reconstruct exact calibration eligible openings and freeze constant comparator, question IDs and hashes.
Implement opt-in shared penalty calculation without changing default paths; validate mask/reset/finite/think/temperature ordering and default equivalence.

effect_protocol.data: New registered training validation questions only; one seed; screening and confirmation separate. IDs and size not frozen here.
effect_protocol.primary: Thinking-token reduction with accuracy retention; total tokens also reported.
effect_protocol.support: Candidate must offer useful paired accuracy/token tradeoff versus both RC14 and constant weaker penalty, then independent confirmation. No universal 5% floor.
effect_protocol.reject: No benefit beyond fixed weakening, no compression improvement, increased unresolved caps, or accuracy evidence incompatible with accepted bound. Do not retune on same validation questions.
effect_protocol.interaction: Four R-containing arms distinguish coordination from weaker suppression, not strict R-by-CGRS synergy. Strict synergy additionally needs U and matching lexical-only arms.
